title: Core 26 Equal Game-Ready Species Certification Standard
equality_rule: Every Core-26 species is measured against the same dimensions. Historical coverage, familiarity, humanoid shape, storage location or amount of recovered source material may not lower the certification bar.

dimensions.description: Current canonical name/identity, exact version and provenance resolve without legacy-name ambiguity.
Claims are sourced/owner-authorized and unresolved facts remain explicit.
A current SpeciesDefinition or governed canonical equivalent exists and resolves through current catalogs.
Creation/selection grants, alternatives, gates and incomplete/illegal states are executable and validated.
Body plan, limbs/manipulators, worn regions and attachment points are typed for shared consumers.
Scale, movement and senses use shared typed capability/rules profiles.
Executable physiology/lifecycle/environment tolerances are explicit and separate from descriptive biology.
Executable species grants and natural equipment have canonical identities and provenance.
Equipment, clothing, tools, implants, vehicles/mount interfaces produce explicit compatibility outcomes.
Lineage/subspecies composition is governed when present; absence is explicit.
Alternate forms/transformation semantics are governed when present; absence is explicit.
Species progression/maturation hooks are governed when present; absence is explicit.
Biological communication, learned language, culture, identity and observer knowledge remain correctly separated.
Playable/incomplete/invalid/migration states, exact-version migration and round-trip persistence are verified.
Runtime contribution is deterministic, source-traceable and does not corrupt base selection history.
Current-authority appearance topology/options/assets and accessible descriptions exist or have explicit source-bounded gaps.
Same species canon is reusable by NPC/Creature and campaign/combat/social/exploration/crafting adapters.
Balance/adjudication status, integration testing and game-ready certification evidence are explicit.

certification_rule.required_or_explicit_not_applicable: must be certified or carry a source-backed explicit_not_applicable receipt
certification_rule.overall_game_ready: all 19 dimensions satisfy their requirement and no unresolved mandatory gap remains
certification_rule.no_inference: missing canon or mechanics may not be fabricated to make a row pass

terminal_proof: MVPS-23 must run all 26 real species records through this same standard.
